title: The Speedy PB&J (sample)
original:
1. Put peanut butter on the bread.
2. Put jelly on the other bread.
3. Put the bread together.
4. Cut it in half.
5. Enjoy!

steps.text: Put peanut butter on the bread.
steps.note: The jar is closed and the bread is in a closed bag, so the whole jar goes on the bag.

steps.text: Put jelly on the other bread.
steps.note: There is no other bread out, so 'the other bread' is still the bag. The closed jelly jar stacks on top of the peanut butter jar.
Only one 'bread' exists (the bag), so there is nothing to put together. Confused.
No knife named and none in hand, so a robot chop. The bag gets squished. No injuries, just squished bread.
Robots don't eat. Chef Byte presents it proudly.

missing: Open the bread bag (untwist the twist tie).
Take two slices of bread out of the bag.
Twist the lid off each jar.
Pick up the butter knife and use it to spread.
Say which side goes in when you put the slices together.

fixes.text: Untwist the tie and open the bread bag.
Take two slices of bread out of the bag.
Twist the lid off the peanut butter jar.
Twist the lid off the jelly jar.
Flip the jelly slice over so the jelly faces down.
Put one slice of bread on the plate.

result: A closed jelly jar sitting on a closed peanut butter jar sitting on a squished, closed bag of bread.
